description: Hides Thunderbird's main window to the Windows system tray on minimize.

functions.name: watch
functions.description: Starts watching every open (and future) mail:3pane window, hiding it to the system tray whenever it is minimized.

functions.name: startMinimized
functions.description: Hides the main window to the system tray as soon as it finishes loading. Intended to be called once at extension startup when the user has enabled "start minimized".

functions.name: syncTraySettings
functions.description: Applies the user's tray preferences to Thunderbird's native mail.closeToTray / mail.closeToTray.startInTray prefs. When startMinimized is on but enableCloseToTray is off, mail.closeToTray is only turned on right before Thunderbird quits (so native start-in-tray fires with zero flash on the next boot) and turned back off once running, so the close (X) button keeps its normal behavior.

functions.name: restoreMessagePaneStateIfNeeded
functions.description: Works around a Thunderbird bug where the thread pane / message pane split (the #threadPane element's inline height, in classic layout) gets reset when the window is hidden to tray at startup. Compares the current height against the last known-good snapshot (captured whenever this add-on hides the window) and restores it if they differ.
